candidates.name: Gamestoria
findings: Current homepage lists Sunday Pioneer at 3pm, while the calendar and detailed weekly page list 2pm and retain obsolete pandemic access text.
The homepage has current November 2026 announcements; that does not resolve the conflicting weekly schedule.

The publicly embedded Google Calendar ID was used only to identify its standard public ICS URL. Fresh calendar.google.com/robots.txt returned 200 and disallowed retrieval; no calendar payload was fetched.

candidates.name: Brooklyn Pop-Up
findings: The official HTML is a Softr app shell with a public markets-list configuration, not an embedded dated event manifest.
Its explicitly linked renderer could not be inspected under normal access guards because assets.softr-files.com/robots.txt returned403. The script and unverified backend routes were not fetched.
Public search results include stale 2025 markets and partner appearances already covered by existing New York sources. No new dated occurrence is asserted from those results.
